concepts.def: From hydration of ethene or fermentation

walkthroughs.body_html:
C10H22 -> C8H18 + C2H4.

Atoms balance: C 10=10, H 22=22.

The alkene is useful for polymers.

CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O.

Always balance C, then H, then O.

Ethene CH2=CH2 -> (-CH2-CH2-)n.

Mr of repeat unit = 28. Polymer of 100 units = Mr 2800.
